title: Teal painted boards
design: MUTED DEEP TEAL PAINTED WOOD BOARDS: four or five simple narrow VERTICAL boards, straight shallow seam gaps and fine vertical wood grain beneath mostly intact matte paint. Small edge rubs showing warm wood, no huge peeling patch. No shutter outer frame, hinges, bolts, diagonal brace, wall or window: just the repeatable painted board surface for shutters, doors and trim.

variants.title: Sage painted boards
variants.color: soft muted sage green, gently sun-faded

variants.title: Dusty blue painted boards
variants.color: dusty desaturated coastal blue, neither turquoise nor bright cobalt

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production-oriented seamless tiling ALBEDO / BASE-COLOUR material texture for the painted seaside village houses. This is a MATERIAL SURFACE ONLY, not a building, sample board or rendered object.
Reference images supply only painted material style, fine warm outlines and palette. Fill an entire 1024x1024 square with the specified surface, viewed orthographically STRAIGHT ON, at 90 degrees to the surface. No perspective, isometric view, horizon, border, frame, labels, text, watermark, tile palette, isolated object or blank margins.
Make the pattern genuinely TILEABLE left-to-right and top-to-bottom: matching motif phase, joints and average colour at opposite edges, with no edge darkening, vignette, centre spotlight, large isolated stain or unique focal feature. Light is flat diffuse and colour-balanced, no cast shadows, reflections, directional sunlight or photographic highlights baked into the tile. Keep shallow painted occlusion in joints restrained.
Style: detailed hand-painted game texture matching the supplied house art, warm dark-brown delicate joint lines, softly painted surfaces, clear medium-scale texture and restrained salt/weather wear. Clean readable material structure at distance, not noisy photorealistic grunge or a flat colour. Opaque full-colour square texture, no transparency.
SURFACE:
MUTED DEEP TEAL PAINTED WOOD BOARDS: four or five simple narrow VERTICAL boards, straight shallow seam gaps and fine vertical wood grain beneath mostly intact matte paint. Small edge rubs showing warm wood, no huge peeling patch. No shutter outer frame, hinges, bolts, diagonal brace, wall or window: just the repeatable painted board surface for shutters, doors and trim.
